title: S-Agent 2.0: Spatial Reasoning with a General Coding Agent
abstract: arXiv:2610.28354v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Spatial reasoning asks a model to work out where objects are in 3D space, how they relate to one another, and how they move. Agentic VLMs have recently brought large improvements on such tasks by letting the model actively gather evidence with 3D perception tools instead of answering in a single pass. Even so, on many questions the tools return the right evidence and the model still does not arrive at the correct answer: the gap between model and tools, where raw readings become usable conclusions, is left unfilled. We present S-Agent 2.0, a spatial reasoning agent that equips an off-the-shelf general coding agent with a command-line perception toolkit, and we design the interface around one principle: help the VLM close the evidence loop: acquire scene evidence, remember it in a persistent scene memory, and interpret each reading in plain spatial language. translated_title: S-Agent 2.0：基于通用编程智能体的空间推理
translated_abstract: 空间推理要求模型判断物体在三维空间中的位置、它们之间的相互关系以及它们的运动方式。智能体化的视觉语言模型（Agentic VLMs）最近通过让模型主动使用3D感知工具收集证据、而非一次性直接作答，在这类任务上带来了大幅提升。即便如此，在许多问题上，即使工具返回了正确的证据，模型仍然无法得出正确答案：模型与工具之间的鸿沟——即原始读数转化为可用结论的环节——依然未被填补。我们提出了S-Agent 2.0，这是一个空间推理智能体，它为现成的通用编程智能体配备了一套命令行感知工具包，并围绕一个原则设计接口：帮助VLM闭合证据回路——获取场景证据，将其保存在持久化的场景记忆中，并用通俗的空间语言解读每一次读数。这一设计保留了编程智能体的全部灵活性，并且它获取的每一次读数……
tldr: S-Agent 2.0通过为通用编程智能体配备命令行感知工具包、持久化场景记忆和通俗空间语言解读机制，帮助视觉语言模型闭合“证据获取到结论”的回路，从而显著提升空间推理能力。
en_tdlr: S-Agent 2.0 equips an off-the-shelf general coding agent with a command-line perception toolkit, persistent scene memory, and plain spatial language interpretation, helping VLMs close the evidence loop to improve spatial reasoning.
